verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia tool supports creating mock servers (including AI-generated mocks from prompts/OpenAPI specs) that let a user exercise API test flows without hitting production endpoints, and decK/DB-less deployment supports spinning up isolated local Gateway instances for testing. However, there is no documented 'sandbox' environment concept specific to Kong Gateway or AI Gateway itself, no staging/production data-isolation guarantees, and no independent corroboration of this workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment feature for Kong Gateway/AI Gateway, first-party guidance on production-data isolation, and independent hands-on validation.
